info.title: MarketBox 2.0 Open API
info.description: The MarketBox public API. Use this API to manage bookings, orders, service offerings, and suppliers across your MarketBox projects. All endpoints are versioned under `/v1` and authenticated with an API key in the `x-api-key` header.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key minted in the MarketBox dashboard. Scope is restricted to the projects you select at creation time.

post.summary: Find providers + suggested/open slots for a service, location and window
post.description:
Resolves matching providers from project data and returns suggested slots, open slots, and (for recurring requests) recurrence patterns. Requires `serviceId` + `offeringId` and EITHER `locationId` OR both `lat` + `lng`.

For recurring requests (`bookingType: "recurring"`): `lookAheadStartDate` MUST carry a numeric timezone offset (e.g. `+00:00`), not a `Z` suffix, and `rrule` MUST include a bounded `COUNT` — either omission returns a 400.

locationId.description: Stored location id. Provide this OR lat+lng.

lat.description: Discovery latitude. Required with lng if locationId is absent.

lng.description: Discovery longitude. Required with lat if locationId is absent.

lookAheadStartDate.description: ISO start of the search window. For recurring requests must carry a numeric offset (e.g. +00:00), not Z.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for returned local times.

rrule.description: Required when bookingType is recurring. Must include a bounded COUNT (e.g. FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU;COUNT=3).

200.description: Suggested slots + open slots. For recurring requests, `timeSlots` holds pattern objects.

timeSlots.description: Suggested slots, or recurring time patterns when bookingType=recurring.

400.description: Validation error (missing location, missing/invalid recurring rrule, Z offset on recurring lookAheadStartDate, or unbounded COUNT)

403.description: API key cannot access this project

post.summary: Generate clustered time slots from providers + engine config
post.description: Lower-level direct engine invocation. You pass the providers (their availability, bookings, blocked time) and an engine config; the engine returns clustered suggested slots plus metrics and KPIs. Reads no project data.

config.description: Engine ClusterConfig (validated loosely; the engine owns the contract).

get.summary: List suppliers for a project, enriched with services and skills

schema.description: Comma-separated service IDs. Returns only suppliers offering every listed service (AND). Combined with `skills` using AND. Empty value is treated as no filter.
